source_data.desc: You touch a willing creature, foretelling an accurate strike. The next attack the creature makes before the end of your next turn hits regardless of any modifiers or the target’s AC.
source_data.higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the number of attacks that creature makes which automatically hit increases by one for every two slot levels above 1st.
source_data.name: Fated Strike

translation_provenance.attribution: DND-BofA curated translation (machine translation, editorial review required)

en.description: You touch a willing creature, foretelling an accurate strike. The next attack the creature makes before the end of your next turn hits regardless of any modifiers or the target’s AC.
en.name: Fated Strike

ru.description: Вы касаетесь согласного существа, предсказывая точный удар. Следующая атака, которую существо совершает до конца вашего следующего хода, попадает независимо от любых модификаторов или КД цели.
ru.name: Роковой удар
